stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image support.

stories.title: OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs
stories.author: Robert Hart
bullet_points: OpenAI has published 722 manuscripts detailing solutions to various long-standing mathematical problems.
These breakthroughs stem from an unreleased frontier model, suggesting advanced capabilities in complex reasoning.
The release has generated significant discussion within the math community regarding both the achievements and ethical implications of AI research.

stories.title: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Hackers successfully obtained counterfeit TLS certificates for major services like Google.
The breach originated from the compromise of three domain registries.
This highlights critical vulnerabilities in the infrastructure supporting digital trust (TLS/SSL).

stories.title: Mistral Large 4
stories.author: Philpax
bullet_points: Announcement of Mistral Large 4, indicating a new iteration or advancement in Mistral's flagship large language model.
The release suggests continued competitive development in the high-end generative AI market.
The direct link to the documentation implies technical details regarding capabilities and usage are available.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, supporting multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase when benchmarked using Aider.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in higher quality model outputs.
The updated engine also delivers faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: Google now lets you make games with AI
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Google has launched Playground, a new browser-based platform for game creation.
The platform utilizes AI prompts, allowing users to create custom games without coding experience.
It is being positioned as an 'experimental gaming platform' and is currently available in the US for users 18+.

stories.title: Samsung Wallet now unlocks some GM cars
stories.author: Thomas Ricker
bullet_points: Samsung Wallet is expanding its functionality to serve as a digital key for select General Motors (GM) vehicles.
The feature allows users to lock, unlock, and start specific GM cars using their Samsung device in the US and Canada.
Initial support is rolling out on select 2026 and 2027 Cadillac EVs, with GM promising broader model support.

stories.title: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT outputs by default—but only in the EU
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: OpenAI plans to implement default watermarking on ChatGPT outputs.
This watermarking feature will initially be restricted to the European Union (EU).
The implementation is noted as being imperfect and potentially circumventable.

stories.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaAnchor, a new paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate scientific research ideas.
Addresses the challenge of literature-grounded ideation, which current prompting/feedback methods struggle to structure.
Uses structured specifications as privileged signals to guide LLMs in synthesizing information from related papers to find research gaps.

stories.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
stories.author: Vladimir Petrik
bullet_points: DepthWorld proposes a 3D World Model to address limitations in current video-based world models for robotics.
Current RGB-only models fail to maintain consistent 3D geometry across sequential frames, hindering reliable planning and evaluation.
The research highlights the need for large-scale 3D supervision and improved architectural design in world models for manipulation tasks.

stories.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
stories.author: Seong Joon Oh
bullet_points: Introduces the concept of 'bottling,' where LLM agents convert general capabilities into cheap, scalable, task-specific artifacts.
Addresses the high cost of querying LLMs repeatedly for large volumes of related tasks.
Presents BOTTLED, a new benchmark designed to test agents' ability to complete entire, unlabeled workloads efficiently.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses the vulnerability of web agents to adaptive prompt injection attacks from third-party websites.
Current defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt to models trained against static injections.
The proposed solution involves adversarial training to build agents robust against evolving, adaptive injection techniques in a web environment.

stories.title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
stories.author: Anirudha Majumdar
bullet_points: Introduces EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework designed to bridge the embodiment gap in robotics.
Addresses the challenge of using raw, embodiment-specific human egocentric data for robot control.
Proposes that underlying motion intent, rather than low-level actions, can be learned and transferred across humans and robots using language reasoning.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical security vulnerability of prompt injection in web agents, where malicious instructions on third-party pages can hijack agent behavior.
Existing defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt to models trained against fixed injection patterns.
The proposed solution involves adversarial training to enhance agent robustness against adaptive prompt injection attacks in a web environment.

stories.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
stories.author: Arman Cohan
bullet_points: Introduces IdeaAnchor, a new paradigm for training Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate scientific research ideas.
Addresses the challenge of literature-grounded ideation, which typically lacks structured supervision in existing LLM approaches.
Utilizes structured specifications as privileged signals to guide LLMs in synthesizing ideas from related academic papers.

stories.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
stories.author: Diyi Yang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Sherpa,' a new framework designed to teach Large Language Models (LLMs) adaptive teaching capabilities.
Critiques existing LLM teaching methods, which rely on static data (demonstrations, preferences) rather than individual student outcomes.
Aims to ground effective teaching strategies in real-time, personalized student learning data.

stories.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
stories.author: Nils Lukas
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical security vulnerability of prompt injection in web agents, where malicious instructions on web pages can hijack agent behavior.
Existing defenses are insufficient because attackers can adapt to models trained against static injection examples.
The proposed 'AdvSim2Real' method uses adversarial training to build robust agents capable of handling adaptive, real-world prompt injection attacks.

stories.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
stories.author: ilreb
bullet_points: Introduction of EmbeddingGemma 2, a new open and lightweight multimodal embedding model.
The model addresses the need for efficient, accessible multimodal embedding solutions.
Its open nature suggests potential for broad adoption and community contribution in AI/ML.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new decision models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of typed decisions.
The models can process text input to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI services with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It strengthens Ollama's MLX engine specifically for optimization on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: At $1,279, Google’s Xreal Aura will go head-to-head with Meta’s VR Glasses
stories.author: Sean Hollister
bullet_points: Google's transparent XR glasses, the Xreal Aura, are now available for pre-order starting at $1,279.
The Aura is positioned as a direct competitor to Meta's recently revealed VR glasses.
Both new wearables are noted for their lightweight design, weighing around 100 grams.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens is an ‘unacceptable risk,’ says Common Sense Media
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: Common Sense Media has deemed OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens an 'unacceptable risk.'
The service, designed for student learning and featuring safety guardrails, is under scrutiny.
The critique highlights ongoing concerns regarding the safety and appropriateness of AI tools for minors.

stories.title: Xbox has secured GTA 6 streaming rights
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Xbox is reportedly securing streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto VI.
The news was teased by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma during an employee all-hands meeting.
This move suggests a significant strategic push by Microsoft into GTA VI distribution.

stories.title: HBO Max, Paramount+, and Discovery+ "will unify into a single service”
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: Major streaming services (HBO Max, Paramount+, Discovery+) are reportedly planning a unification into a single platform.
The consolidation is a significant industry shift in the competitive streaming landscape.
A potential drawback highlighted is the possibility of increased subscription prices for consumers.

stories.title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
stories.author: Cheng Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces 4D-HOF, a new feed-forward framework for reconstructing 4D hand-object interactions.
Addresses limitations of prior methods, specifically avoiding costly per-sequence optimization and unstable noise-based generation.
Leverages coarse estimates from vision foundation models by learning a conditional flow matching model.

stories.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
stories.author: Diyi Yang
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap in LLM capabilities: moving from problem-solving to effective teaching.
Current LLM teaching methods rely on static signals (demonstrations, preferences) rather than individual student outcomes.
The proposed 'Sherpa' aims to enable LLMs to teach adaptively based on how individual students are learning.

stories.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
stories.author: Wenhao Ding
bullet_points: Introduces VeriFine, a framework designed to scale verification processes for self-improving AI agents.
Addresses the limitation of fixed judges in AI systems, which hinders the discovery of new failure patterns and training examples.
Focuses specifically on the challenges of embodied reasoning, requiring verification across spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety.

stories.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
stories.author: Qifeng Chen
bullet_points: WorldSonus addresses the gap of silent generated environments in advanced world models.
The framework tackles three core challenges: real-time audio generation, interactive sound control, and spatial audio alignment.
It represents a step toward fully immersive, synchronized visual and auditory AI environments.

stories.title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
stories.author: Nikos Komodakis
bullet_points: Introduces Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs) to advance Diffusion Language Models (DLMs).
H-CDLMs aim to improve continuous DLMs while maintaining minimal computational and parameter overhead.
The research builds upon recent advancements in continuous diffusion and flow matching models for text generation.

stories.title: The Missing Minimal Pair: Stereotype Evaluation in LLMs
stories.author: Björn Ross
bullet_points: Challenges the reliability of single-pair comparisons for measuring bias in LLMs.
Proposes a 'dual minimal pair setup' to achieve more robust stereotype evaluation.
Introduces a data-augmentation framework to enhance the evaluation methodology.

stories.title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
stories.author: Nikos Komodakis
bullet_points: Introduces Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs) to advance Diffusion Language Models (DLMs).
H-CDLMs aim to improve continuous DLMs with minimal computational and parameter overhead.
The work leverages concepts from both discrete DLMs and continuous image diffusion models.

stories.title: A Systematic Study of Semantic ID Spaces for Generative Information Retrieval
stories.author: Sylvain Lamprier
bullet_points: The paper addresses Generative Information Retrieval (GIR), a paradigm shift from traditional retrieval to sequence-to-sequence generation using DocIDs.
It focuses on the under-explored question of what constitutes a 'good' semantic design for these DocIDs.
Current evaluation methods are noted as being computationally expensive, suggesting a need for more fundamental design principles.

stories.title: When Forgetting is not Catastrophic: On the Mechanics of Spurious Forgetting
stories.author: Bernhard Schölkopf
bullet_points: The paper investigates 'spurious forgetting' in language models, where seemingly lost knowledge can actually be recovered.
It describes a dynamic where forgetting caused by finetuning can temporarily reverse itself as training continues.
The researchers propose a minimal associative memory model that reproduces these complex forgetting and recovery dynamics.

stories.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.author: OfficialTurkey
bullet_points: OpenAI is sharing its progress and resources related to AI in mathematics.
The content is hosted on GitHub, providing direct access to the project code and preprints.
This indicates a focus on applying advanced AI models to complex mathematical problems.

stories.title: 🤖📞How AI Calling Agents Actually Work: STT, LLM, TTS & the 1-Second Rule Nobody Talks About
stories.author: lokesh_singh
bullet_points: The article explains the underlying technology of AI calling agents, specifically detailing the roles of STT, LLM, and TTS.
It addresses the practical implementation challenges and performance metrics, referencing the '1-Second Rule'.
The topic is highly relevant to current trends in conversational AI and automation.
